olivia-sales: Quick check-in 90FinGate wants a Private air-gapped POC with their VaultX HSM. Deliverables: short preflight checklist, an offline test vector (sign + wrap), and a clear FAQ line about billing when HSM is customer-provided. Who owns?

marco-crypto: I can own preflight + minimal test vector. Questions: wrapped CEK flow vs import, attestation format, rotation cadence (customer wants manual ceremony, CFO prefers monthly).

olivia-sales: They will provide wrapped CEKs (customer KEK). Attestations are x509 blobs signed by VaultX. Manual ceremony preferred but open to approval-driven automation.

(sanjay-ops): Ops notes: we need serial console access for install, offline artifact transfer (SCP to jumpbox), and PKCS#11 path + slot info. Billing: one-time SOW install fee + monthly Private node. We don't bill for customer's HSM. Optional managed-rotation add-on has surcharge.

marco-crypto: TEST VECTOR (minimal):
1) payload: echo -n "rgw-test" > p.bin
2) sign: pkcs11-tool --module /opt/vaultx/libpv.so -l --pin 0000 -y privkey -i p.bin -o s.bin
3) verify: openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature s.bin p.bin
WRAP: pkcs11-tool --wrap-key -i cek.bin -o cek.wrapped --module /opt/vaultx/libpv.so -l --pin 0000
Expected: verify -> "Verified OK", unwrap yields original CEK.

marco-crypto: Failure notes: CKR_PIN_INCORRECT = bad PIN, CKR_SLOT_ID_INVALID = wrong slot, attestation cert chain fail = check trust-anchor thumbprint.

tess-legal: Contract language for questionnaire: "Customer retains sole control of KEKs. Redwood accepts wrapped CEKs and performs in-memory unwrap only during active sessions; unwrapped keys are not persisted. Import/unwrap events are logged and retained for 12 months. Vendor HSM attestation and SOC2/FIPS docs required for production onboarding."

olivia-sales: Great. Next: Marco finalize doc + test vector (EOD), Sanjay add billing bullets and SOW line items, Tess attach custody paragraph in questionnaire answer. I'll bundle and send to FinGate.

deploy-bot: Uploaded draft to /confluence/pocs/vingate-vaultx-preflight v0.1

olivia-sales: Thanks team, will schedule customer walkthrough after packet is reviewed. :thumbsup:
